profiles.name: Story
profiles.description: Relaxed battles. Enemy levels stay below the expected story level, with forgiving HP and damage.

profiles.name: Normal
profiles.description: A fair challenge. Enemies trail the expected level by one; leveling and equipment give you an edge.

profiles.name: Hard
profiles.description: Enemies meet the expected level for your current story progress and hit harder.

profiles.name: Nightmare
profiles.description: Enemies sit one level above the expected progression and demand careful skills and teamwork.

notes: Level expectations assume some optional hunts/patrols: Parts 1–2 Lv1, 3–5 Lv2, 6–8 Lv3, 9–11 Lv4; each difficulty shifts the enemy target. Targets depend on campaign chapter, not your exact current level, so grinding still helps. Existing HP and damage multipliers are retained; named scripted bosses/duels use their original difficulty behavior.
